rails.source: Gemfile.lock (gem 'rails', '~> 8.0.0'); Phase 15 (branch upgrade/phase-15-rails-8-0, stacked on Phase 13 #235; main is at 7.2.4)
rails.load_defaults: 7.2 (config/application.rb); config/initializers/new_framework_defaults_8_0.rb present with every key commented out (to_time_preserves_timezone = :zone, strict_freshness, Regexp.timeout = 1)
rails.notes: 8.0.5.1 is the newest 8.0 release (gem_lines.py, 2026-10-25) and the first supported-again target, but only until 2026-11-07, so Phase 16 (8.1.4, security fixes until 2027-10-10) should follow promptly. Requires Ruby >= 3.2 (Ruby 3.4.12 since Phase 13). load_defaults 7.2 turned on YJIT in every environment (the finisher does not check the environment), postgresql_adapter_decode_dates and validate_migration_timestamps; 8.0's 7.2 block no longer sets active_job.enqueue_after_transaction_commit. Rails 8.0 emits four `to_time` deprecation warnings per boot until to_time_preserves_timezone = :zone (Phase 16). Regexp.timeout = 1 is part of load_defaults 8.0, not an unconditional 8.0 default, so it is still nil. db/schema.rb now dumps `enable_extension "pg_catalog.plpgsql"`. rack is 3.2.7 since Phase 12 (rack-protection 4.2.1, rack-session 2.1.2, rackup 2.3.1). The Phase 11 cookie rotator (SHA1 → SHA256 key generator) was removed in Phase 12, so Phase 12 must only reach production after Phase 11 has been live long enough for the old cookies to have been rewritten.
